inputs.text: Martin is pointing to increased tenancies, but that’s exactly the kind of reassuring number that can be used to steer attention away from what’s getting worse: eviction notices and homelessness are rising, and emergency accommodation numbers nationally have climbed again. The six-year lease rules introduced by the Government on March 1 may be part of the machinery behind this, not proof that the crisis is being solved. They want people to see more tenancies and stop asking who is being pushed out—and why.
